title: Chemical Drain Cleaners vs. Mechanical Clearing
description: Many property owners believe chemical drain cleaners are a quick, safe solution for stubborn clogs. In reality, liquid chemical cleaners often pool behind total blockages, generating intense exothermic heat. This reaction can soften or deform PVC and ABS drain lines, ruin wax toilet seals, or accelerate corrosion in older metallic piping. Furthermore, standing chemical pools present severe chemical burn risks to plumbers who must later disassemble the piping. Mechanical clearing using a hand snake or drum auger physically extracts the obstruction without risking pipe wall structural integrity, seal damage, or technician safety.

Furthermore, standing chemical pools present severe chemical burn risks to plumbers who must later disassemble the piping. Mechanical clearing using a hand snake or drum auger physically extracts the obstruction without risking pipe wall structural integrity, seal damage, or technician safety.
